A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a method to hallucinate facial expression details in a 3D face model.
we introduce a novel method that hallucinates facial details from a 2D image to 3D geometry that is then rendered to a novel view.
we introduce a novel 3D face representation, which is able to generate fine geometric details for a given expression.
The main takeaway from our work is that
facial details can be learned in a data-driven way, and used to generate photo-realistic novel images in a single image-to-image translation framework.

facial expressions are highly correlated with the facial geometry and thus the geometric details can be hallucinated by learning to disentangle the facial expression and the geometry from single images.
the facial details are not only important for the realism of the rendered image, but they are also important for the correct expression of the rendered image.
